# technitium_dhcp_leases (Data Source)

Lists DHCP leases currently held by clients, dynamic or reserved. A reservation shows up once a client claims it; unclaimed reservations are only part of the scope.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scope` (String) Only leases from this scope.

### Read-Only

- `leases` (List of Object) Leases: `scope`, `type` (`Dynamic`/`Reserved`), `hardware_address`, `client_identifier`, `address`, `host_name`, `lease_obtained`, `lease_expires`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--leases))

<a id="nestedatt--leases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `leases`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `client_identifier` (String)
- `hardware_address` (String)
- `host_name` (String)
- `lease_expires` (String)
- `lease_obtained` (String)
- `scope` (String)
- `type` (String)
